svg.title: SMPTE RP 219-1:2014 HD Color Bars and PLUGE, 1920 by 1080
svg.text: SMPTE RP 219-1:2014 — HD Color Bars + PLUGE
1920×1080 narrow-range BT.709, drawn 1:1. Fills preview the stored 10-bit codes with (code × 255 + 511) / 1023.

g.text: Pattern 1 rows 0–629 · Pattern 2 rows 630–719 · Pattern 3 rows 720–809 · Pattern 4 rows 810–1079
Pattern 3 ramp: x = 446 through 1473, codes 64 to 940. Pattern 4 PLUGE: −2% = 46, +2% = 82, +4% = 99.
Section 4.1 defaults: *1 is 40% gray, *2 is 75% white, *3 is 0% black. Sub-black valley and super-white peak are not generated.
